# Adon assets used by Easy Screen Capture

Source: the owner-supplied **Adon – Creative Agency Portfolio HTML Template** archive, version 1.0.0, by ravextheme.
Selected demo: `light/ai-agency.html`.

- `fonts/`: BDO Grotesk Regular, Medium, DemiBold and Astro Nebula Light, as supplied with the template.
- `js/`: GSAP 3.12.2 and ScrollTrigger 3.12.2, with original copyright/license headers preserved.
- `shapes/`: original AI Agency decorative WebP assets (shape-s-5 and shape-s-7 through shape-s-12).
- `src/styles/adon/ai-source.css`: the AI Agency section of the supplied stylesheet, attributed in the file header.

These files support this end product. They are third-party assets and are not relicensed as original project code. The full template archive and unrelated demos are not included. Product illustrations are authored in `AdonPreview.astro`.
